description: This Java class defines the WorkingDays entity within the Fineract project, representing the working days configuration including recurrence, rescheduling type, and holiday adjustments. It includes methods to update these properties based on incoming JSON commands.

classes.name: WorkingDays
classes.description: Entity class representing working days configuration with properties like recurrence, rescheduling type, and holiday adjustment flags.

methods.name: WorkingDays
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a WorkingDays instance with specified recurrence, rescheduling type, and holiday adjustment flags.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the WorkingDays instance properties based on parameters received in a JsonCommand object, returning a map of actual changes applied.
